bugs.error_message: Compiled dist/**/*.js contained no "use client" directives anywhere after `tsup` build (verified via `head -c N` on every output file) — RSC client/server boundaries would have been silently broken for any Server Component importing an interactive package component.
bugs.root_cause: tsup's default esbuild bundling (bundle: true, ESM code-splitting across 5 barrel entry points) merges multiple source modules into shared chunks. esbuild treats the bare `"use client";` string-literal expression statement as dead code (it isn't part of the ECMAScript spec) and strips it during bundling, regardless of which source files it came from.
bugs.fix: Set `bundle: false` in tsup.config.ts so every src/**/*.{ts,tsx} file transpiles 1:1 into dist/ with no chunk merging, which preserves the directive naturally per file. Added packages/shadcn/scripts/postbuild-use-client.mjs as a safety net that reads each dist file's .js.map `sources` array and re-prepends "use client" if a compiled file traces back to a source file that has it but the directive is missing.

bugs.error_message: next build failed prerendering /mui: "Error: Event handlers cannot be passed to Client Component props. {value: 4.5, ..., onChange: function onChange}" — thrown from the Rating component nested inside ProductCard/ProductGrid on a Server Component page.
bugs.root_cause: Rating.tsx (and, identically, TextField/Textarea/Select/Autocomplete/Checkbox/Switch/RadioGroup/DateField) unconditionally built an inline arrow-function onChange handler and passed it to the underlying MUI component on every render, even when the wrapper's own `onChange` prop was undefined (the common read-only/display case, e.g. `<Rating value={4.5} readOnly />` inside a product card on an otherwise-static Server Component page). A freshly-created closure is not serializable across the RSC boundary, so React throws as soon as a Server Component's render tree hands a Client Component a function prop — even an effectively-inert one.
bugs.fix: Guard every wrapped onChange/onCheckedChange handler: only construct and pass the closure when the caller actually supplied a callback (`onChange ? (e) => onChange(...) : undefined`), otherwise pass `undefined` through. Left mandatory-callback components (SearchField, ProductQuantitySelector, FileUpload) unguarded since they're inherently interactive and always require a client boundary already established by the caller.

bugs.error_message: Browser console warning in dev: "React does not recognize the `alignItems`/`justifyContent`/`flexWrap` prop on a DOM element" when using the package's Stack component with `align`/`justify`/`wrap` props.
bugs.root_cause: Assumed MUI's Stack (@mui/material 9.3.1) forwards arbitrary CSS-named props like alignItems/justifyContent/flexWrap as system-style shorthand the way Box does. In this version Stack only intercepts direction/spacing/divider/useFlexGap as first-class props — everything else falls through `...other` straight onto the root DOM element.
bugs.fix: Route align/justify/wrap through the `sx` prop instead of passing them as direct props to MuiStack.
